paper: EFS: Evolutionary Factor Searching for Sparse Portfolio Optimization Using Large Language Models
source_choice: v1 supplies the released prompts and US50 list; this does not splice the materially different v2 mechanism into v1
m_conflict_resolution: m=10 main real-market table rather than contradictory m=5 setup prose
factor_admission: positive historical RankIC and past top-m mean return above contemporaneous equally weighted eligible universe
factor_selection: highest trailing mean RankIC, tie by unannualized Sharpe then name/hash; retain latest and best version per base
normalization: cross-sectional min-max [-1,1] per factor; constants zero; arithmetic average of selected factor scores
initial_price_normalization: 100 at first observed prehistory close (earliest 2018-10-01); IPO prehistory never backfilled
price_adjustment: abs(prc)/adjfct from JKP daily CRSP-derived panel; prc_adj convention checked in JKP code
formation_execution: observe close t, compute next target, execute close t+1, first earn t+1 to t+2 return
feedback_timing: only realized outcomes through decision close t, from signals no later than t-2
missing_policy: eligible only with 30 finite positive past closes; fail on missing selected execution price or held realization, never reweight on future availability
preserved: published source prompt content after TeX formatting removal
real LLM mutation and crossover with anonymized performance feedback
daily close/return inputs with 30-observation factor histories
weekly search and daily long-only top-m equal-weight allocation
version diversity, factor validation, and performance feedback loop
approximated: alternative JKP daily data rather than unreleased vendor snapshot
current GPT-4.1 endpoint rather than original historical model
one search trajectory rather than authors pooled three trajectories
execution timing delayed one trading session for causal feasibility
invented: exact pool pruning, admission, normalization, and numerical conventions
decoding/token limits and zero automatic retry
limitations: static paper-selected universe contains selection/survivorship concerns
current-model historical replay can contain pretraining information
no released author EFS code or factor pool
new strategy outcomes are retrospective evidence
factor-source equivalence is not original-pipeline or paper-number reproduction
